blocks.text: Still job hunting? JobQuestPH is bringing its LAST MEGA JOB FAIR of the year to Megatrade Hall 3, SM Megamall on September 29, 2026, from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM. And this time, it’s more than a one-day job fair. Onsite. Virtual. AI-Assisted. Meet participating employers onsite, explore Local & Overseas job opportunities, submit your resume, and potentially undergo initial interviews. Then continue your job search through the 4-Day Virtual Job Fair from September 30–October 3 for local opportunities. JobQuestPH has also launched its new AI-powered recruitment website, giving registered jobseekers access to: FREE IQ & EQ Assessments FREE AI Job Match Resume upload and […]...
